source.dataset_title: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit — global color map (visualization only)

credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio. CGI Moon Kit, SVS visualization 4720 (https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720).
usage: Visualization only — not an analysis input.
assumptions: Projection: Global 2:1 map 'centered on 0° longitude' (SVS page). The page names no projection and no numeric longitude range; LUNARIS ASSUMES simple cylindrical (equirectangular) spanning −180°..+180° longitude and +90°..−90° latitude
